Privacy Notice

How information is handled when you visit this website or follow its links.

Information you share

This website does not have an enquiry form or accept document uploads. Telephone and WhatsApp enquiries take place outside the website. Please avoid sending sensitive documents until you have agreed an appropriate way to share them with the advocate.

Website activity

The website does not use advertising scripts, marketing cookies or analytics trackers. The hosting provider may process technical information, such as an IP address and requested page, to deliver the site and maintain security.

Hosting

This public website is hosted on GitHub Pages and does not require a visitor account. GitHub processes technical information under its privacy statement.

External links

Following a court-resource, directory or WhatsApp link takes you to a separately operated service. Its own privacy policy and terms apply to your activity there.

Questions

For questions about information on this website, please use the contact options on the Contact & Chambers page.
